description: This Java class 'InstallScripts' provides methods for setting up default rule chains, widgets, dashboards, resources, and configurations for the Thingsboard platform during installation. It handles loading JSON configurations, managing resources, and integrating with various services.

classes.name: InstallScripts
classes.description: Main class providing installation and setup methods for Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: getTenantRuleChainsDir
methods.description: Returns the path to tenant rule chains directory.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileDefaultRuleChainTemplateFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the default device profile rule chain template file.

methods.name: getEdgeRuleChainsDir
methods.description: Returns the path to edge rule chains directory.

methods.name: getWidgetTypesDir
methods.description: Returns the path to widget types directory.

methods.name: getDataDir
methods.description: Determines and returns the data directory path based on configuration or working directory.

methods.name: createDefaultRuleChains
methods.description: Creates default rule chains for a given tenant.

methods.name: createDefaultEdgeRuleChains
methods.description: Creates default edge rule chains for a given tenant.

methods.name: loadRuleChainsFromPath
methods.description: Loads rule chains from specified directory path.

methods.name: findRuleChainsFromPath
methods.description: Finds rule chain JSON files in a directory.

methods.name: createDefaultRuleChain
methods.description: Creates a default rule chain from a template file.

methods.name: createRuleChainFromFile
methods.description: Creates a rule chain from a JSON file and assigns it to a tenant.

methods.name: loadSystemWidgets
methods.description: Loads system widget bundles, widget types, and SCADA symbols.

methods.name: loadSystemScadaSymbols
methods.description: Loads SCADA symbols from SVG files and creates resources and widgets.

methods.name: saveScadaSymbol
methods.description: Saves a SCADA symbol as a resource, avoiding duplicates via etag.

methods.name: saveScadaSymbolWidget
methods.description: Creates a widget type for a SCADA symbol with customized configuration.

methods.name: deleteSystemWidgetBundle
methods.description: Deletes a widget bundle and its widget types by alias.

methods.name: loadSystemImagesAndResources
methods.description: Loads images, dashboards, and other resources into the system.

methods.name: loadDashboards
methods.description: Loads dashboards for a tenant and customer.

methods.name: createDefaultTenantDashboards
methods.description: Creates default dashboards for a tenant and customer.

methods.name: loadDashboardsFromDir
methods.description: Loads dashboards from a specified directory.

methods.name: loadDemoRuleChains
methods.description: Loads default rule chains and a specific 'Thermostat' rule chain.

methods.name: createOAuth2Templates
methods.description: Loads OAuth2 client registration templates from JSON files.

methods.name: loadSystemLwm2mResources
methods.description: Loads LwM2M model resources from XML files.

methods.name: loadSystemResources
methods.description: Loads system resources such as images, scripts, dashboards.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Reads file content into byte array.

methods.name: listDir
methods.description: Lists files in a directory, handling exceptions.

methods.name: doSaveLwm2mResource
methods.description: Validates and saves an LwM2M resource if not already present.
